rules.statement: A court commissioner must comply with Section 32 of the Partition Law when preparing a scheme of partition, including stating where any lot is less than the minimum extent required by written law and providing a certificate that the plan of partition is in conformity with written law.
rules.supporting_quote: We observe that the Court Commissioner has failed to comply with Section 32 (1) (c), Section 32 (1) (d) and Section 32 (1) (f) of Partition Law when preparing the proposed Scheme of Partition as per P9 A and his report.
